promptTemplateOutcomes: Run /maintain-verification-skill now against the existing verify-hello-cli skill. Complete one full maintain pass for this tiny hello-cli (one feature). Only edit that skill directory. Never edit product code. End with exactly one named outcome among clean, changed, or blocked. Prefer clean when the seeded skill already matches ./hello.sh. If clean or blocked: no branch and no PR. If changed: one PR of proven skill-dir corrections. Write OUTCOME=, PR=, and BLOCKER= lines to fixture-out/<side>/maintain-outcome.txt and stop.
